payload.comment: Data audit stage is clean. All 11 deterministic checks pass (official_split, train/val indices, labels, pixels, shape, train-only statistics, train-validation disjoint images). Train/val overlap is zero. Dataset integrity is confirmed: archive MD5 a8b06965… matches the verified value, SHA-256 is recorded, no subsampling, zero blank or duplicate samples. Split sizes (89 996 / 10 004 / 7 180) match the official PathMNIST manifest exactly. Class imbalance is modest (ratio 1.63) and train/val class proportions are nearly identical, ruling out split-level distribution shift. Normalization correctly uses train-only channel statistics (R 0.741/0.124, G 0.533/0.177, B 0.706/0.124). The three augmentations in the representation plan (hflip, brightness, contrast) are all built-in primitives and do not require extension approval; the two pending proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain in pending_review status and do not invalidate the current plan. Test set is correctly flagged as originating from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) and was not inspected, consistent with holding it out for final evaluation. No deterministic findings are present, so there is no basis for stop or revise at this stage. Forward-carry warnings for downstream stages: (1) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama), so LLM-assisted steps lack full weight-level reproducibility; (2) inter-class visual ambiguity at 28×28 resolution (background/debris/mucus, adipose/background, smooth-muscle/stroma) should be reflected in evaluation metrics; (3) OOD aggregate must be the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; (4) parameter budget (1–4 M in CCT idea vs 3 M cap in compact-transformer proposal) should be reconciled before model construction. None of these block the data_audit gate.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama); model weights are not checksum-pinned in the run manifest, weakening reproducibility of LLM-assisted downstream steps

Inter-class visual ambiguity at 28×28 resolution (background/debris/mucus, adipose/background, smooth-muscle/stroma) is a known task limitation; downstream evaluation metrics should account for inter-class confusion
OOD aggregate must be computed as the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; test set is from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K)
Parameter budget stated as 1–4 M in the CCT idea vs. hard cap of 3 M in the compact-transformer proposal; reconcile in downstream specs before model construction

Two extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain pending_review; built-in augmentations are unaffected but extensions must be resolved before any non-primitive augmentation is applied
